doc.brief: The QSplitter class implements a splitter widget.

QByteArray saveState() const.brief: Saves the state of the splitter's layout.

QList<int> sizes() const.brief: Returns a list of the size parameters of all the widgets in this splitter.

QSize minimumSizeHint() const override.brief: Reimplements an access function for property: [QWidget::minimumSizeHint](xref:qt:QWidget).

QSplitter(QWidget *parent).brief: Constructs a horizontal splitter with the *parent* argument passed on to the [QFrame](xref:qt:QFrame) constructor.

QSplitter(Qt::Orientation orientation, Q.brief: Constructs a splitter with the given *orientation* and *parent*.

QSplitterHandle * createHandle().brief: Returns a new splitter handle as a child widget of this splitter.

QSplitterHandle * handle(int index) cons.brief: Returns the handle to the left of (or above) the item in the splitter's layout at the given *index*, or `nullptr` if there is no such item.

QWidget * replaceWidget(int index, QWidg.brief: Replaces the widget in the splitter's layout at the given *index* by *widget*.

QWidget * widget(int index) const.brief: Returns the widget at the given *index* in the splitter's layout, or `nullptr` if there is no such widget.

Qt::Orientation orientation() const.brief: This property holds the orientation of the splitter

bool childrenCollapsible() const.brief: This property holds whether child widgets can be resized down to size 0 by the user

bool isCollapsible(int index) const.brief: Returns `true` if the widget at *index* is collapsible, otherwise returns `false`.

bool opaqueResize() const.brief: Returns `true` if widgets are resized dynamically (opaquely) while interactively moving the splitter.

bool restoreState(const QByteArray &stat.brief: Restores the splitter's layout to the *state* specified.

int closestLegalPosition(int pos, int in.brief: Returns the closest legal position to *pos* of the widget at *index*.

int count() const.brief: Returns the number of widgets contained in the splitter's layout.

int handleWidth() const.brief: This property holds the width of the splitter handles

int indexOf(QWidget *widget) const.brief: Returns the index in the splitter's layout of the specified *widget*, or -1 if *widget* is not found.

void addWidget(QWidget *widget).brief: Adds the given *widget* to the splitter's layout after all the other items.

void getRange(int index, int *min, int *.brief: Returns the valid range of the splitter at *index* in **min* and **max* if *min* and *max* are not 0.

void insertWidget(int index, QWidget *wi.brief: Inserts the *widget* specified into the splitter's layout at the given *index*.

void moveSplitter(int pos, int index).brief: Moves the left or top edge of the splitter handle at *index* as close as possible to position *pos*, which is the distance from the left or top edge of the widget.

void setChildrenCollapsible(bool).brief: This property holds whether child widgets can be resized down to size 0 by the user

void setCollapsible(int index, bool coll.brief: Sets whether the child widget at *index* is collapsible to *collapse*.

void setHandleWidth(int).brief: This property holds the width of the splitter handles

void setOpaqueResize(bool opaque).brief: Returns `true` if widgets are resized dynamically (opaquely) while interactively moving the splitter.

void setOrientation(Qt::Orientation).brief: This property holds the orientation of the splitter

void setRubberBand(int pos).brief: Displays a rubber band at position *pos*.

void setSizes(const QList<int> &list).brief: Sets the child widgets' respective sizes to the values given in the *list*.

void setStretchFactor(int index, int str.brief: Updates the size policy of the widget at position *index* to have a stretch factor of *stretch*.

void splitterMoved(int pos, int index).brief: This signal is emitted when the splitter handle at a particular *index* has been moved to position *pos*.

childrenCollapsible.brief: Whether child widgets can be resized down to size 0 by the user

handleWidth.brief: The width of the splitter handles
